name: scientist-laboratory
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original role-card illustration for a bridge engineering academic website.
Style/medium: elegant architectural pencil and ink sketch; hand-drawn graphite and charcoal linework, delicate crosshatching, slight construction lines, carefully observed engineering objects. Predominantly monochrome dark lines with very restrained muted-purple accent strokes.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly plain white background; standalone isolated subject; no full room or scenery.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 canvas; centered composition with generous white margins on every side; keep all objects uncropped. Quiet scholarly precision.
Constraints: no people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no collage, no UI chrome. Sketch should remain readable when reduced to a small website card. Dark lines on white.
Primary request: A civil engineering laboratory vignette: a compact structural beam test frame with two vertical steel columns, a crosshead, hydraulic loading actuator and small simply supported rectangular concrete beam beneath it. A dial gauge and caliper rest alongside on a minimal workbench. Technically plausible but artistically simplified.
